mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document ( title, content, knowledge_scope, source_type, topic, priority, enabled, indexed_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{knowledgeScope}, #{sourceType}, #{topic}, #{priority}, #{enabled}, #{indexedStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET indexed_status = #{indexedStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
